proof:
intro s a b f C hm hb
have he : essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (KdVPlan.hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc a b)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C :=
 essSup_le_of_ae_le (ENNReal.ofReal C) (hb.mono fun t ht => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ht.2)

have hn := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top he
simpa only [KdVPlan.EssH, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal'] using hn
